item.title: A Good-Looking CS2 Inventory for $55: Three Sets That Don't Look Cheap
item.description: What $55 gets you in CS2: three ready-made sets in blue, red and green — no knife, no gloves — that look like one coordinated loadout.

item.title: Which gloves go with a purple knife: pairs for three budgets
item.description: Purple knife in CS2 means Ultraviolet or Doppler Phase 2. Gloves that match: Mogul, Finish Line, Needle Point, Violet Beadwork, Plum Quill — with real prices.

item.title: What to Pair With the AK-47 Redline: Knife, Gloves and Pistols in One Style
item.description: The AK-47 Redline is the most popular red-and-black skin in CS2. Here's which knife, gloves, M4, AWP and pistols to build around it on any budget.
